gaps.lead: I'd rather you didn't tell anyone about this.
gaps.explanation: keep something to yourself = tell nobody.

gaps.lead: 'I never wrote that review,' the chef insisted.
I can't wait for the holidays to start.
gaps.explanation: look forward TO + -ing: the 'to' is a preposition.

gaps.lead: Everyone thought the concert was excellent.
gaps.explanation: 'Everyone thought it excellent' → 'made an excellent impression on everyone'.

gaps.lead: It was unfair of the referee to send him off.
gaps.explanation: should(n't) have + participle criticises a past decision.

gaps.lead: He couldn't swim until he was twenty.
gaps.sentence: He ___ swim until he was twenty.
gaps.explanation: couldn't = was not able to (general ability in the past).
